messages:
Alex (AE): FYI starting POC plan for ACME. They need semantic search + assistant for support docs. Can SEs help scope success criteria and integration checklist? Timeline: 4 weeks preferred.

Maria (SE): Thanks. Key Qs: dataset size? expected qps? SLOs (latency/p50, p95)? uptime/SLA needs? any on-prem/KMS constraints?

Alex (AE): Customer: ~200k docs, peak 40 qps, want p50 <300ms, p95 <800ms for search. Must keep data in their VPC and use customer-managed keys. No external logging to 3rd parties.

Maria (SE): Ok. Proposed success criteria:
- Search recall >= 0.78 on eval set
- Assistant answer accuracy >= 0.85 measured on 200 prompt evals
- End-to-end p50 <300ms for queries in hosted + dedicated fallback
- Cost target under $0.15/1k tokens for steady-state

Jared (Eng): Integration notes: we'll recommend Redwood SDK streaming for assistant, bearer auth via service account key for POC. If they require SAML/KMS, Private deployment + KMS integration. For POC we can do hosted with VPC peering and bring-your-own KMS (BYOK).

Maria (SE): Rate limits/quotas: propose 60 qps per project initially with 4 concurrent streams, burst to 120 for 30s. Retries: exponential backoff 200ms base, max 5 retries for 429/503. Circuit-breaker on sustained 5% error rate.

Jared (Eng): Example SDK snippet for streaming + retries:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.chat.stream(model="redwood-2l", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"..."}], timeout=30)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
And headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-account-token>, X-Project-ID: acme-poc

Priya (Sales Ops): Pricing: POC discount 50% on tokens for first month. Dedicated quote depends on committed vGPU hours. I'll put numbers in a follow-up.

Maria (SE): Action items:
- Alex: confirm eval prompts and provide 200 evals (due EOD Thu)
- Jared: share sample code + rate limit config in repo (by Tue)
- Priya: draft POC pricing + T&Cs (by Mon)
- I'll spin up a test project and enable BYOK test keys

Alex (AE): Thanks team. Tagging @ci-bot for quick infra deploy when ready :rocket:

ci-bot: deploy started for project acme-poc, job 8843. logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/8843

Maria (SE): Noted. We'll sync with ACME on Wed 11am to validate success metrics.

Alex (AE): Perfect.
